description.value: Overall dysphagia severity / functional oral-intake measures for the stroke care transition (DOSS + IDDSI Functional Diet Scale reused from SNOMED; FOIS as a temporary local code pending LOINC/SNOMED submission). DIGEST is deliberately excluded: it is validated for head-and-neck-cancer radiation toxicity, not for stroke, and is surveyed in the coverage assessment only. Its temporary code remains in the local CodeSystem as an upstream-submission candidate.
